```{r}
incel_clean <- incels[
  !is.na(text) & trimws(text) != ""
]
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Create a date variable from the Unix timestamp
incel_clean <- incel_clean %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.POSIXct(timestamp, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")),
    month = floor_date(date, unit = "month")
  )

# Check the date range
range(incel_clean$date, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check the number of comments per month
incel_clean %>%
  count(month, sort = FALSE) %>%
  print(n = 20)
```
```{r}
# Define the new set of lexicon terms
lexicon_terms <- c(
  "Chad" = "\\bchad\\b",
  "Cuck" = "\\bcuck\\b",
  "Truecel" = "\\btruecel\\b",
  "LDAR" = "\\bldar\\b",
  "Betabuxx" = "\\bbetabuxx\\b",
  "Mogger" = "\\bmogger\\b"
)

# Count total comments per month
monthly_totals <- incel_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
  count(month, name = "Total_Comments")

# Count comments containing each term by month
term_trends <- map_dfr(names(lexicon_terms), function(term) {

  pattern <- lexicon_terms[[term]]

  incel_clean %>%
    filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
    group_by(month) %>%
    summarise(
      Term_Count = sum(
        str_detect(
          coalesce(text, ""),
          regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Term = term)
})

# Calculate the percentage of comments containing each term
term_trends <- term_trends %>%
  left_join(monthly_totals, by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Term_Count / Total_Comments * 100
  )

# Set the order of the terms in the legend
term_trends$Term <- factor(
  term_trends$Term,
  levels = names(lexicon_terms)
)

# Create the visualization
ggplot(
  term_trends,
  aes(
    x = month,
    y = Percentage,
    color = Term
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "The Evolution of Incel Language, 2017–2023",
    subtitle = "Monthly percentage of comments containing selected lexicon terms",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Comments Containing Term (%)",
    color = "Lexicon Term",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: Incels.is comment dataset and Appendix A: Incel Lexicon.",
      "Each line represents the percentage of monthly comments containing a term."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

# Candidate phrases to investigate
candidate_terms <- c(
  "I want to" = "\\bi want to\\b",
  "I'm going to" = "\\bi['’]?m going to\\b",
  "I will" = "\\bi will\\b",
  "planning to" = "\\bplanning to\\b",
  "my plan" = "\\bmy plan\\b",
  "take action" = "\\btake action\\b",
  "make them pay" = "\\bmake them pay\\b",
  "get revenge" = "\\bget revenge\\b",
  "kill them" = "\\bkill them\\b",
  "shoot up" = "\\bshoot up\\b",
  "carry out an attack" = "\\bcarry out an attack\\b",
  "buy a gun" = "\\bbuy a gun\\b",
  "get a weapon" = "\\bget a weapon\\b"
)
```

```{r}
# Count matching comments for each phrase
candidate_counts <- map_dfr(
  names(candidate_terms),
  function(term) {
    pattern <- candidate_terms[[term]]

    tibble(
      Term = term,
      Comment_Count = sum(
        str_detect(
          coalesce(incel_clean$text, ""),
          regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  }
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Comment_Count))

candidate_counts
```
```{r}
candidate_examples <- map_dfr(
  names(candidate_terms),
  function(term) {

    pattern <- candidate_terms[[term]]

    matches <- incel_clean %>%
      filter(
        str_detect(
          coalesce(text, ""),
          regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
        )
      )

    matches %>%
      slice_sample(n = min(20, nrow(matches))) %>%
      select(user, date, text) %>%
      mutate(Term = term)
  }
)

View(candidate_examples)
```

```{r}
priority_examples <- candidate_examples %>%
  filter(Term %in% c(
    "buy a gun",
    "shoot up",
    "kill them",
    "get revenge"
  )) %>%
  select(Term, date, text)

View(priority_examples)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Prepare the candidate examples for manual review
candidate_review_sheet <- candidate_examples %>%
  distinct(text, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Remove duplicate comments
  select(Term, date, user, text) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = "",
    Notes = ""
  ) %>%
  relocate(Label, Notes, .after = text)

# Export to CSV
write.csv(
  candidate_review_sheet,
  "~/Downloads/candidate_examples_review_sheet.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# Check how many comments were exported
nrow(candidate_review_sheet)
```

```{r}

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# Start with the original Reddit scrape
# Assumes your original dataset is called `incels`

# Define keyword groups for different mental health topics
mental_health_terms <- list(

  mental_health = paste0(
    "\\bmental health\\b|\\bmental illness\\b|",
    "\\bmentally ill\\b|\\bpsychological\\b|",
    "\\bpsychiatric\\b"
  ),

  depression_anxiety = paste0(
    "\\bdepress(?:ion|ed|ing|ive)?\\b|",
    "\\banxiet(?:y|ies|ious)\\b|",
    "\\bpanic attack\\b|\\bpanic disorder\\b|",
    "\\bbipolar\\b|\\bptsd\\b|",
    "\\btrauma\\b|\\btraumatized\\b"
  ),

  seeking_help = paste0(
    "\\bseek(?:ing)? help\\b|\\bget help\\b|",
    "\\bneed help\\b|\\bask for help\\b|",
    "\\breach out\\b|\\btalk to someone\\b|",
    "\\bprofessional help\\b|\\bmental health support\\b"
  ),

  therapy_and_treatment = paste0(
    "\\btherap(?:y|ist|ists|ies|eutic)\\b|",
    "\\bcounsel(?:ing|ling|or|lor)\\b|",
    "\\bpsychiatrist\\b|\\bpsychologist\\b|",
    "\\bmedication\\b|\\bantidepressants?\\b|",
    "\\bssri\\b|\\btreatment\\b"
  ),

  social_support = paste0(
    "\\bsupport group\\b|\\bvent(?:ing)?\\b|",
    "\\bconfide\\b|\\bopen up\\b|",
    "\\bfriends to talk to\\b|\\bfamily support\\b|",
    "\\bfeel alone\\b|\\bloneliness\\b|",
    "\\bno one to talk to\\b"
  ),

  coping_and_improvement = paste0(
    "\\bcope\\b|\\bcoping\\b|\\bself[- ]care\\b|",
    "\\bmanage my emotions\\b|\\bfeel better\\b|",
    "\\bimprove my mental health\\b|",
    "\\bchange my mindset\\b|\\bbuild confidence\\b|",
    "\\bself[- ]improvement\\b"
  ),

  suicide_and_self_harm = paste0(
    "\\bsuicid(?:e|al)\\b|\\bkill myself\\b|",
    "\\bend my life\\b|\\bself[- ]harm\\b|",
    "\\bself[- ]injur(?:y|e|ing)\\b|",
    "\\bwant to die\\b|\\bthoughts of dying\\b"
  )
)

# Create a searchable version of the comment text
incels_with_topics <- incels %>%
  filter(!is.na(text), str_trim(text) != "") %>%
  mutate(text_search = str_to_lower(text))

# Flag each topic separately
for (topic in names(mental_health_terms)) {
  incels_with_topics[[paste0("mh_", topic)]] <-
    str_detect(
      incels_with_topics$text_search,
      regex(mental_health_terms[[topic]], ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
}

# Keep comments matching at least one topic
mental_health_subset <- incels_with_topics %>%
  filter(if_any(starts_with("mh_"), ~ .x)) %>%
  mutate(
    Mental_Health_Topics = apply(
      select(., starts_with("mh_")),
      1,
      function(x) {
        matched <- names(x)[as.logical(x)]
        paste(
          str_remove(matched, "^mh_"),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-text_search)

# Check the results
nrow(mental_health_subset)

mental_health_subset %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      starts_with("mh_"),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# Save the subset as a CSV file
write.csv(
  mental_health_subset,
  "~/Downloads/mental_health_subset.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
candidate_examples_labeled <- read_csv("candidate_examples_labeled(Labeled Comments) (1).csv")
View(candidate_examples_labeled)
```


```{r}
# Create a filtered dataset for analysis
candidate_analysis <- candidate_examples_labeled %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Label),
    Label != "",
    Label != "Unclear or unrelated"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = factor(
      Label,
      levels = c(
        "Specific action or planning",
        "Advocacy or encouragement",
        "General violent rhetoric",
        "Hypothetical, joke, or quotation",
        "Self-harm related"
      )
    )
  )

# Check how many comments remain
nrow(candidate_analysis)

# Check the remaining label distribution
candidate_analysis %>%
  count(Label, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Check the dataset
glimpse(candidate_analysis)

# Number of comments in each label category
label_summary <- candidate_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(Label), Label != "") %>%
  count(Label, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

print(label_summary)

# Visualize the distribution
ggplot(label_summary, aes(x = reorder(Label, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Action-Oriented Comment Types",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of comments"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# Count comments by phrase and label
term_label_counts <- candidate_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(Label), Label != "") %>%
  count(Term, Label)

# Calculate the label distribution within each phrase
term_label_percent <- term_label_counts %>%
  group_by(Term) %>%
  mutate(Percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

print(term_label_percent)

# Plot the distribution for each phrase
ggplot(
  term_label_percent,
  aes(x = Term, y = Percent, fill = Label)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Types of Language Associated With Each Phrase",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of sampled comments",
    fill = "Comment label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# Convert dates and group by month and label
monthly_labels <- candidate_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(Label), Label != "") %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    month = floor_date(date, unit = "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
  count(month, Label) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  mutate(Percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot category proportions over time
ggplot(
  monthly_labels,
  aes(x = month, y = Percent, color = Label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Action-Oriented Comment Categories Over Time",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Percentage of sampled comments",
    color = "Comment label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# Number of distinct users represented in each category
users_by_label <- candidate_analysis %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Label), Label != "",
    !is.na(user), user != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  summarise(
    Comments = n(),
    Distinct_users = n_distinct(user),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(users_by_label)

# How many different labels are represented for each user?
user_label_diversity <- candidate_analysis %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Label), Label != "",
    !is.na(user), user != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(user) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_sampled_comments = n(),
    Number_of_label_categories = n_distinct(Label),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(user_label_diversity)
```
